Name: Jojarola Razr for Mobile Phone
Author: collarsandcandy
Description:
You moved back to Grandpa's farm to get away from the stress of the modern world. A mobile phone is handy to have, but the latest models are just so addictive and troublesome. Lucky for you, Grandpa kept that old lunchbox you meant to bury as a time capsule and inside was your old Jojarola Razr! A much better choice for a low-tech farm life!


This mod is simple, but I think effective at helping with immersion while using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017?tab=description]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] mod! The skins I've seen others make are wonderful, but they're all smartphones and a smartphone in the context of Stardew's inciting action doesn't really make much sense to me. So I took it upon myself to whip up a retro skin pack for it! The obvious inspiration for the skin is the first phone I ever had & acquired while I was still living on my family's farm so it felt very fitting; I actually did the pixelart by just looking at it since it sits on my desk as decoration to this day! I tried to keep it cohesive with Stardew's art style, but it's definitely still a bit higher resolution than the rest of the game. I might do a version 2 that brings it closer in line to that style if there's enough demand for it or if I get the itch to. The pack has 7 colours all modeled after retail colours of the Razr v3. The coloured variants aren't really accurate to the real deal since you can't see the shade when looking at the screen irl, but I tinted the reflective screen barrier and added a small bit of the case colour to the top of the phone anyway. It also includes a recreation of the actual wallpaper I have on my old Razr along with a more pixelated alt incase you want that.

This DOES include a config file that WILL overwrite your current one. This is because I had to very specifically adjust the size and position of the screen and icons to make the mod overlay screen sit neatly within the screen on the skin. I tried to get it as perfect as I could, but there's a couple janky things I couldn't quite fix like the corners being squared and the customization screen being weird when the phone is turned. But otherwise, it should be fine!

This is my first mod for Stardew and my first upload here on Nexus so if anything is broken or I messed something up, let me know in the forum comments! ૮ ྀིᴗ͈ . ᴗ͈ ྀིა
